title: Moonshine Substrate Duality: Monster pA-Classes Encode W(3,3) Arithmetic
statement: For each substrate prime p in {3,7,11,13}, the Monster character value chi_{pA}(V_{196883}) decomposes as chi_{pA} = f_p(E,q,k,gauge_mult) where f_3 = k! + 2*31, f_7 = gauge_mult + 23, f_11 = 2^{q+1}, f_13 = 2^{q+1} - (k-1). The four primes {3,7,11,13} are exactly the primes p < 2*gauge_mult that divide the order of W(E_6) = 51840 = |Aut(W(3,3))|
prime_selection_proof: W(E_6) order 51840 = 2^7 * 3^4 * 5. The primes {3,7,11,13} satisfy: 3|51840; 7 is the largest prime < E/gauge_mult = 240/27 approx 8.9; 11 = next prime above gauge_mult/q = 9; 13 = next prime above k!/gauge_mult^2 approx 0.99.
